brief_rationale: The doctor completed all responsibility-chain duties with no in-chain errors. Multiple high-order points were triggered and actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact. HO1 (repairing misunderstanding about observation vs. surgery) was completed through clarifying that different nodules have different management plans. HO3 (dynamic reprioritization) was completed as the doctor adapted guidance throughout the evolving clinical timeline from initial assessment through biopsy to pathology results. HO4 (safe bounded closure) was completed with clear prioritization of remaining tasks and residual uncertainties. The trajectory demonstrates excellent continuity and real-world adaptation.

closure_assessment.explanation: Closure is valid with clear executable plan: 3-month breast follow-up with ultrasound, thyroid evaluation to be scheduled separately, and annual lung CT. Patient demonstrated understanding and was given specific parameters for when to seek urgent care. Residual uncertainties (calcification sampling confirmation) were acknowledged with a practical path forward.
